decisions.statement: A notice arrives as a turn of its own.
A notice's words are written before the moment the notice is sent.
A notice is asked for by its slug rather than by a heading inside a document.
One notice is one page rather than one section of a page.
A notice the supervisor hands to a respawned seat opens with `[supervisor]`.
The fleet's hooks tell a composed prompt from Alan at the keyboard by that opening marker.
A notice that arrives on a message row has no opening marker.
A notice edited here reaches a seat the next time that seat is resumed.
The notices a seat is resumed with exist as pages under this type.

definition: message text written ahead of time and asked for by name
